user.title: Bouygue Bbox registration

data_description.host: Use mabbox.bytel.fr (not the IP address of the Bbox).
data_description.password: Leave empty to read only the public data. With the password, the connected devices, the Wi-Fi state and the Speedtest are also read.

user.description: Leave the password empty to use only the public data of the Bbox (Internet link, Wi-Fi switches, UPnP/WPS, latencies, LAN traffic...). The password additionally unlocks the connected devices (device trackers), the detailed Wi-Fi state and the Speedtest.

reauth_confirm.title: Bbox authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The Bbox refused the password. Enter the new password, or leave it empty to read only the public data.

error.no_identifier: Failed to retrieve the LAN MAC address of the Bbox via its API
error.redirect: The Bbox redirected the request (usual when using its IP address). Use the host name mabbox.bytel.fr instead.
error.dns_error: The host name can not be resolved. Check the DNS of Home Assistant (mabbox.bytel.fr must resolve to the Bbox).
error.invalid_response: The answer is not a valid Bbox API response.

abort.wrong_account: This is not the Bbox of this configuration.

data_description.track_devices: Needs the Bbox password: without it no device is tracked.
